items.title: What happens when an LLM never sees material beyond fifth grade?
AI has access to a vastly larger working memory than the human brain
items.blurb: The key advantage may not be superior reasoning, but a virtually unlimited symbolic working memory.

items.title: Are Latent Reasoning Models Easily Interpretable?
items.blurb: Models normally do all their reasoning in a continuous hidden state instead of spitting out readable text which makes them hard to monitor.
